title: A flow's result follows the user across steps - floating window off the last step
description: Leaving a flow's last step tears the result out of the DOM: audio playback stops, and returning shows an empty pane. Frame-wide, every flow. Fabio's spec: while a result exists and the user is NOT on the last step, it rides in a floating window top-right (video looping silently, image as a thumbnail, audio as the player); on the last step the floating window goes away and the result shows in its normal box.
